objective.name: mailbox_entry
objective.description: Defines one mailbox entry used to track the priority and ownership state of a message awaiting or undergoing consumption.

functional._message_id_note: Required. Identifier of the durable message stored in the associated continuity.
functional._priority_note: Required. Priority assigned when the message enters the mailbox.
functional._status_note: Required. Current consumption state of the mailbox entry. failed: the treatment of the message failed three times; the entry is parked, never claimed again, and no longer blocks the messages after it.
functional._claimed_by_note: Optional. Run identifier owning the entry when status is claimed. Null or absent when status is pending or failed.
functional._attempts_note: Optional. Number of treatments of the message that failed (a release reporting a failure counts one). Absent: none.
functional._message_fingerprint_note: Optional. Fingerprint of the content of the message that the entry reserves or tracks (sha256 of from, kind, content and correlation). It lets a retry of the same message_id be told from a different message that reuses the id.
